Definition: {the Nethinim, or Temple-servants (as given to that duty)}
BiblicalUsage: The Nethinim are the temple servants, given to the work of the house of God, and the king's decree protects them: no toll, tribute, or custom may be laid on any priest, Levite, singer, porter, Nethinim, or minister of the house of God.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that God protects the lowest servants of His house as carefully as the priests — the decree names them all, and no tax touches any of them.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
